reviews.t: The reason Lanôme Mascara costs so much is because it's the best!
reviews.x: This stuff? Don't waste you $. Sure, it's cheap; looks good for 5 minutes, then it transfers to under your brows and your eyes - your basic racoon!  Unlike my Lanôme mascara, which comes off easily with (you know it) Lanôme eye make-up remover, this stuff took forever and left the skin around my eyes kind of 'uncomfortable'.

reviews.t: Amazing if you want long lashes! Not super full though
reviews.x: I found this product because I was watching Bailey Sarian on Facebook. She said it was one of her go-to mascaras. It looked amazing on her! I thought it would be super expensive but I was completely wrong! It separated my lashes and added length. They *almost* look like falsies. Just wish the volume would've been thicker. Can't go beyond a couple of coats before it starts to get clumpy. I did take a quick nap after wearing it all day and woke up with mascara flakes under my eye but they were eas

I am a firm believer that you get what you pay for with make up and hair products. I can count on one time how many times I’ve bought a cheap product that works as well as this one. For years I’ve spent $25 or more on the high-end brands of mascara. No more. This mascara is better than any of the benefit brand. Better than It cosmetics . Better than any drugstore brand like Maybeline. It is literally amazing. Now have all my friends hooked on it. Stays put , gives volume and no clumps. Trust me

I have used Tarte Lights camera Action for many years but wanted to try something else. This mascara is a really amazing alternative to it, I actually think I like it more. I didn't get the waterproof but it still stays in place without droop for the whole day and takes effort to remove. I use a lash comb to separate my lashes right after I put it on and it stays. will for sure order again!
Not the best "false lash" look but great for the price!

reviews.t: Fabulous mascara, better than the top brands
reviews.x: LOVE! After purchasing Younique,  Tarte and all the other really amazing mascaras out there I was shocked at how much I prefer this one! My lashes look awesome.  It's now my go to mascara. It is waterproof and takes a bit to take off of you're just using soap.  So get yourself some eye makeup remover. If you are reading this because you're on the fence,  treat yourself! You'll be glad you did!

The only thing I don’t like about the mascara is that over time if does smudge but it’s an awesome value gir the money and just as good as a $25 mascara  I really like the design too. The wand is a big deal when it comes to mascara so if that’s wrong doesn’t matter how good the ingredients in tha mascara in it won’t apply correctly. It has a great wand.
This mascara makes my eyelashes look long and full without giving me spider eyes.  This is a must try and the price is incredible!
Easy to remove,  works well. Good product for small price.

How's on very smooth and does not clump. If you want to lengthen your eyelashes I suggest layering it on and waiting fifty seconds in between each coat as well as as only brushing one way. The down side is it is a little difficult to remove with just face wash or soap and water. I recommend using make up remover to completely remove the mascara.  Do I recommend, yes I do. I will definitely be purchasing again once I run out. Highly recommend it.

I had heard tale of this magic mascara for quite some time and finally tried it for only $4. Well worth it. I was totally suprised at the level of coverage and the transformation of my lashes. I have a sensitivity to certain mascaras and this one is not only smudgeproof and waterproof I have zero issues as the day goes on. Even if I workout with it on. No problems. I am recommending it to all of my friends and will be buying it from now on!

Don’t fall for the hype. It’s not worth it

I Do not like the way it smudges so easily.... however it is hard to remove the smudges once they're on my face. The amount of smudges is kind of surprising considering it doesn't look like I have a large amount of mascara on my lashes when it's applied

She told her that of all the high dollar brands, this inexpensive mascara was her favorite.  I chimed in to concur.  Amazon easy delivery made it too easy to get what I wanted FAST.

reviews.t: I wanted to love this... but couldn't
reviews.x: This product got rave reviews, and i wanted to believe them. But sadly, the product ran down my face while i was working in an air conditioned office all day. It smudged, it ran, and it came off long before i was done with work. Not my favorite, but at least it was cheap. I'll stick to paying money for stuff that works going forward.

This is me in my Essence Disney Princess Mascara Collection. I'm  wearing the "Snow White" version. I like that so far after 3 weeks of usage. The brush hasn't become caked with thick, yucky, clumps of "mascara sludge" in this brand. Ladies you might want to get yourself a tube or all four of the Disney Princess Mascara collection!

I bought this after seeing @mothercould show how amazing it was on her lashes and while yes I do get some length and curl from it I also get clumps. So I wind up with spider eyes and then flakes a bit while weary. Getting it off takes some work as well, but might be easier with makeup remover instead of the gentle soap I use.

Did my lashes look a lot longer? I don't know. I DO know that I curled my lashes real real good, then applied this mascara, and all the curl came out. My lashes instantly drooped all the way. Not at all impressed with this product. I guess one good thing I can say is that it doesn't clump? Whatever, I threw it in the trash.

I enjoy this mascara but it takes a bit to dry and tends to smear everywhere until it fully dries if you are not careful.  It doesn't give a ton of volume but it gets the job done. When I wash my face at night it does tend to linger some on my under eyes which is kind of bothersome but it is not impossible to come off.

Anytime I'm looking for one of those really expensive high-end quality mascaras I'll type those fancy mascara names then use the word dupe in this pops up almost all the time so I just keep this one because it's just as good as one of the most expensive ones .. if not better love this mascara .. it's so so good

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the value, saying it performs as well as or better than expensive high-end mascaras for a low price.
Many reviewers say it lengthens lashes and applies smoothly without clumping, though some note it lacks volume or a dramatic false-lash effect.
Several reviewers mention it can be difficult to remove with just soap or face wash and recommend using makeup remover.
A few reviewers report smudging or transferring, with one calling it a raccoon-eye effect.
Some reviewers note it stays in place all day without drooping, and a couple highlight that it is cruelty free.
